name: Gabriel Lourenco
event: UFC Fight Night: Bonfim vs. Brady
summary: A 27-year-old Brazilian heavyweight ('The Black Mamba', Chute Boxe; 8-1; 6-foot-2, 76-inch reach) who earned a contract in September with a first-round KO of Charlie Cleveland on the Contender Series as an underdog. Seven of his eight wins are first-round finishes. UFC debut, now against short-notice replacement Thomas Petersen after Alvin Hines withdrew.

how_they_fight.Striking: Aggressive starter who throws heavy combinations early (Rotowire). Cleveland timed him with counters early, then Lourenco caught him with a combination and finished with an elbow and punches at 2:02 of R1. Rotowire's analysts say he needs technical polish.
how_they_fight.Grappling: One submission win (R1, 2025). No wrestling information available.
how_they_fight.Defense: Got hit early by Cleveland's counters. His one loss was a R1 KO (1:20) in his 2021 pro debut.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Everything happens in R1: all seven finishes came in the first round, most of them inside two minutes. His only fight that went past R1 was a 2024 decision. How he copes in R2-R3 against a heavyweight who wrestles and clinches is unknown. (Our data lists a 0:00 finish time for one 2025 regional win, which is probably a record-keeping error.)
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Little to judge. Debuting on a changed opponent: he'd prepared for Hines, a different fighter.

patterns: Seven R1 finishes; all his stoppages come early
Heavy combinations and elbows when the opponent is hurt
Was hit early by counters on DWCS
keys_to_beat: Clinch and wrestle him; make him carry weight
Survive R1 and see what's left in R2-R3

news.text: Original opponent Alvin Hines withdrew citing vertigo.
Thomas Petersen stepped in as the replacement opponent.
Beat Charlie Cleveland by KO (elbow and punches) at 2:02 of R1 on the Contender Series to earn a contract.
